notes: No accepted C++ submission (the three recorded ones are RTE, and segfault on the --max heap). orig.cpp was written for the corpus: a tree DP that merges children left to right, keeping the partial cycle as paths over the subtree's top node and its first and last K leaves, deciding each ring edge at the merge that first joins its leaves and the wrap-around ones at the root. It drops states that can't finish (a cycle closed early, or a boundary leaf needing more ring edges than the K leaves outside it can give) and walks the join edges depth-first, so --max (n = 1000, K = 3 heap) runs in about 2 s against the 10 s limit. It matches an exhaustive Hamiltonian-cycle subset-DP brute on 640 generated cases with n <= 16, and the unpruned DP on 60 cases with n <= 42 and on --max.
